Hello! 

I came across your artwork and immediately fell in love with your delicate art style and was hoping to work with you! I especially like the atmosphere of this illustration of Laplus ^^

Taiyou's information
About the character: silly and shy at first, a bit egotistical and arrogant, but has good intentions. 
Keynotes: cool, pretty, fashionable and enjoys drinking tapioca


Usage: Thumbnail image for ASMR videos, streaming and SNS ! Thank you (●ˇ∀ˇ●)
Additional Notes:
* If I could have a version of the image with no background, that would be ideal
* Having a version with the eyes open and a version with the eyes closed would be nice too (if this is too troublesome, please disregard this)


Please feel free to add in your own ideas however you'd like if you feel inspired! You can make Taiyou as cute or pretty or cool as you'd like -- whatever your interpretation of him is is okay!

Thank you for your consideration (❁´◡`❁)
